title: Neighbours of his boyhood and where musicians lived
summary: Old man Glenn, Joe Brown and Manuel Perez lived near him, and he cannot place George Field's residence.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: But I had old man Glenn in my band for years. But he was way older man than me. Why? Because old man Glenn was living a half a block from me. Oh, yeah. Oh, Joe Brown, another great bass player. He was just living a half a block from me also. I had all good musicians around my house. Manuel Perez, all of them was living close by my house.
Do you remember where did George Field live? The trombone player? No, I don't remember where George Fields was living, no.

I don't exactly remember. What did I tell you? They all used to hang out around at 25. But as far as for knowing his residence number or anything, I never did know it. They all used to hang out around.
